# Quantum-L9 repository birth factory

> Generic L9 repository birth factory. This repository owns how an L9
> repository is born: assembly, compiled-payload verification, birth
> provenance, local validation, publication of the sealed root, and remote
> attestation. It does not own what semantic product is born.

## Authority

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): cross-agent repository operating law
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Claude-specific overlay; never replaces AGENTS.md
- [.l9/architecture.yaml](.l9/architecture.yaml): authoritative factory boundary
- [.l9/ownership.yaml](.l9/ownership.yaml): factory, upstream, and runtime ownership
- [.l9/org-birth-profile.yaml](.l9/org-birth-profile.yaml): organization birth class (not a ProductKind)
- [.l9/repo-workflow.json](.l9/repo-workflow.json): repository execution contract
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): architecture narrative

## Bootstrap and validation

```bash
./bootstrap.sh
make verify
make pr-check
pre-commit run --all-files
```

## Security and review surfaces

- [.pre-commit-config.yaml](.pre-commit-config.yaml): local mechanical checks
- [.semgrep/semgrep-rules.yaml](.semgrep/semgrep-rules.yaml): high-signal repo-local Semgrep rules
- [.gitleaks.toml](.gitleaks.toml): thin extension of the Gitleaks default rule set
- [.coderabbit.yaml](.coderabbit.yaml): L9-aware PR review instructions

CI execution and organization targeting remain centrally owned. Do not add a
repository-local workflow caller to compensate for a central CI gap.

## Birth and product boundaries

- [docs/ops/REPO_BIRTH.md](docs/ops/REPO_BIRTH.md): one-command birth contract
- [docs/WHEN_TO_USE.md](docs/WHEN_TO_USE.md): what the factory decides and what arrives resolved from upstream
- [scripts/birth-runner/payload-ownership.yaml](scripts/birth-runner/payload-ownership.yaml): authoritative-vs-additive payload ownership
- [scripts/birth-runner/schemas/birth-payload.schema.json](scripts/birth-runner/schemas/birth-payload.schema.json): compiled `l9.birth-payload/v1` source contract

Product semantics (ProductTopology, ProductManifest, ProductKind, archetypes)
are determined upstream by `Quantum-L9/.github` `semantics/` and the product
semantic owner, and arrive as resolved inputs. The factory never infers
ProductKind from repository shape, package contents, SDK presence, Gate
presence, repo class, or template ancestry. The Python/FastAPI content under
`src/` is a reference payload, not factory law. Do not vendor or fork centrally
owned CI or governance implementation.
